title: 빈칸 제출
suno_analysis_sp: Pop-punk with high-gain distorted electric guitars and driving acoustic drums. The arrangement features a bright, nasal male vocal delivery in Korean. The bass guitar follows the root notes of the guitar power chords with a picked, overdriven tone. Drums utilize a consistent eighth-note hi-hat pattern and a heavy snare on the backbeat. The tempo is 165 BPM in the key of E Major. Guitars use palm-muted chugging in the verses and wide-open power chords in the chorus. A brief melodic guitar lead appears during the transition to the chorus.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar power chords, driving drums with crash cymbals]

[Verse 1]
[palm-muted guitar, bass and drums continue]
진로상담 카드 나왔어
이름 쓰고 멈췄어
꽃무늬 비어 있어
볼펜 굴려봤어
옆자리는 벌써 다 적었어
의사 교사 프로그래머
나는 빈칸이야
시계만 째깍거려

[Pre-Chorus]
[guitar palm-muting stops, sustained chords]
볼펜 뚜껑 열었다 닫았다
뚜껑이 책상 밑으로

[Chorus]
[full energy, open power chords, heavy snare]
꿈이 없어 미안한 건가
열일곱인데 왜
다 정해야 해
빈칸이면 안 되냐고
